title: Muggaaqime ciggiileyna
intro: Taturte dabaanitteh muuci aydaadu fan cultuh gulguluh yan. giti qaddoowe weem kee shakki ummattah fanat baxace wak, ta taama abeyna miracsenta beyuh doorimeh suge. diini farmo qilsa sinni sunkul, oson fooca fan maaqatta beyeenih miraacisuh gersi mari kattaataanam wacarriyeenih.
clues: Anu nabiyyi lih gexuh doorimeh sugeeh, ken wale barte
Anu Arkik foocal sooleh xagni xayyoowe wak, kee Anu ubleh sinam shakki qimmisse
Anu ni miraac rookitaah, Yalla neh xaaqimeh yan wak xaganal elle sugneh nan exxal soolam abeh suge.
Anu yok afal gersi marah yomcowwe farmo bisoh axcem muggaaqime
Anu sinam wadba fan miraacisuh yallih reeda gee
Anu yok afal qimbimtem duudusam agdubeeh, yi miracsenta ummattah asmat geeh

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
